BrochureContent.Content:
David Ross Estate Agents your local property experts are delighted to present 120 Kickham Road
Kickham Road forms part of the historic Bulfin Estate in Inchicore, a neighbourhood developed in the 1930s and 1940s to provide quality homes for Dublin’s growing communities. Named after Charles Kickham, the renowned Irish novelist, poet and revolutionary, the road reflects the area’s strong cultural and nationalist heritage. Over the decades, it has evolved into one of Dublin 8’s most established residential enclaves, prized for its village atmosphere and proximity to the city centre. Today, Kickham Road seamlessly blends rich local history with the convenience of modern urban living. 
Today, the estate retains its idyllic charm and strong community spirit, highly valued for its unique character and proposed Architectural Conservation Area status. 
This lovely mid-terrace home offers purchasers the opportunity to own a property in an established community while its location offers great convenience, providing quick and easy access to the city centre and an array of amenities just a stone's throw away. 
On the ground floor you will find a large living room to the front of the property and to the rear there is a large dining room leading onto an extended kitchen and a generous downstairs bathroom.  The Kitchen provides direct access to a large private garden.
On the first floor you will find two generously sized double bedrooms and a single room to the rear. 
Number 120 Kickham Road provides an opportunity for families, first time buyers and investors alike to purchase a property that, while in need of some modernisation would be a wonderful home.   Early viewing is highly recommended.
Viewing by appointment only.
